newsitem.title: UK: M.A.I.D says no reason behind shr price dip.
newsitem.headline: M.A.I.D says no reason behind shr price dip.

text.p: Electronic information group M.A.I.D Plc said on Tuesday that it was not aware of any reason behind its recent share price fall and assured shareholders that its trading in 1997 was in line with its expectations.
"Trading in 1997 is in line with the directors' expectations and sales of the company's core Profound product continue to be strong," the company said in a statement.
M.A.I.D said the number of subscribers in the last quarter of 1996 remained consistent with previous quarters and revenue form usage continued to rise.
"Income is now being received from the alliance with CompuServe as anticipated at the time of our results announcement on November 14, 1996," M.A.I.D said in a statment.
The company is expected to announce its preliminary results for full year 1996 on March 13.
